entities.name: Friedrich-Wilhelm von Rothkirch und Panthen

entities.summary: Friedrich-Wilhelm von Rothkirch und Panthen was a German general during World War II. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany. Rothkirch und Panthen retired from active duty on 30 November 1943.
